title: 📊 Daily Report: Fri Nov 13, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,762.13, down $124.31 on the day. Weekly wrap: the strategy bots are up $51.25 against Monday's base and passed the weekly rule; CORE QQQ is down $108.05, so the full book is down $56.47, while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is up $107.75, leaving us $164.22 behind for the week. Since the merge the book is down 11.28% ($2,258.61), while Indy is down 3.11% ($622.36), so we're trailing by $1,636.25.

Sunny was the only bot that traded today: it sold 1 share of MPC for a $20.90 gain, a Friday weekend-gap exit to keep the strategy week green. Three positions remain open (Trek in ACN and VRSN, Sunny in PSX). CORE QQQ is still in, with the trend filter ON (prior close 688.17 vs the 200-day at 680.94); it holds $10,385, or 58% of the book. Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. Idle cash earned $0.70 in interest today.

Research's analyst note for today:
- Chips drove the tape again: NVDA fell for a sixth straight week after Huang's exit, AMD and AVGO led the semis lower, and the Nasdaq lost 0.9%. Still, the S&P snapped a four-week losing streak with a weekly gain of about 2.5%.
- PPI was slightly cooler than expected month over month, but 6.5% year over year is the hottest since 2022. A December hike is still fully priced, and the 10-year touched 5.17%.
- Our calls: skipping the CSCO gap was right (it fell 6% today). PANW gave back its upgrade pop and ended flat on the day, below our entry. COST is up 1.7% since we logged it.
- Weekly hit rate: 1 up, 3 down, 1 voided. New calls averaged -0.7% vs SPY +0.0%. Older beat-and-raise holds kept working: HUM +8%, PLNT +5%, CPAY +3%.
- Next week: NVDA earnings Tue after the close under an interim CEO, plus HD, LOW, TGT, TJX, WMT and PANW. The AI-hardware avoid stays on through NVDA earnings.

Floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Claude impact: First real advice batch (b20261113-012007, Nov 12). Claude reviewed the pre-registered Saturday lab and the planned hiring gate. With CEO approval we tightened the lab write-up (CORE stays in cash until enough price history exists, log the first trend-on date, and add a few extra report metrics, including trade-level results for the earnings-exit test); the pass bar and decision rule were left unchanged. Those lab results are still pending Saturday. We also wrote the hiring-gate spec (not built yet) and, as advised, first fixed Trek's rerun instability: two same-cache reruns now match exactly. The old swings came from different symbol lists and a moving window, not chance. No new P&L from these changes yet.
salmon: Salmon (mascot joke, not a trader): TERAFAB!
